OK so I'm going to rhyme off some things that frustrated me about Reddit, and off the cuff ideas of how to potentially prevent them from happening:

  • Memes - I can't tell you how fucking sick I am of seeing Memes these days. Ever since parents started using them incorrectly about 6 years ago on Facebook, they are dying the slowest, most painful death ever. Can we enforce keeping memes only on "meme-related" subverses? Something that annoyed me about Reddit was having to created a gigantic filter list in RES just to limit the amount of bullshit popping up on my front page. I don't want to have to do that for Voat.

  • Karma Whoring - How about trialling the removal of karma scores on user profiles? A huge problem with Reddit is the sheer volume of piffling childish nonsense due to teenagers karma whoring. Users pretend to be people and fabricate these big stories just to have a high karma score. It's absolutely ridiculous! Surely you can keep the point-scoring system in the back end, but just not on display for the end user? I can understand keeping post scoring on the front page, or in a post etc, but when a user goes on their profile they don't see a score. The point of the website should be good content, not good scores on profiles. It's not a competition. Users don't need to know how high their score is. Perhaps if they gain over a high number they can earn a "Top Contributor" badge for "X" subverse...

  • Hivemind - Make it an absolute necessity site wide with admins/mods that they stop any 'hivemind'-ing in it's tracks. Nothing worse than when someone has a legitimate opinion on a matter and it gets downvoted into oblivion just because they aren't joining in the circle jerk. I see it all the time in Football/Soccer subreddits where a user submits a genuine opnion, backed with facts and evidence and it's got all these downvotes because it wasn't getting on the bandwagon.

  • Transparency - I saw another thread in here asking for the same thing. I think that Voat should be 100% open at all times as to who the investors are, and what their intentions are with the website. There should be no reason not to be open about these things. I don't give a shit HOW MUCH they are investing, I want to know what they plan on doing with the place.

  • Introductions - Please remove this god awful subverse. Absolutely pointless. People should just introduce themselves by joining in discussions about actual topics.
